about: Cuts Ben OK'd by watching before the whole-Short full-bleed rule existed (11 Nov 2026, J2546). The gate still measures them and says what it found, but their padded stretches are a warning, not a FAIL, so the cut he OK'd can still go up as the fallback while its full-frame version waits for his watch. Matched by the file's sha256: a re-cut is never covered. Add an entry only for an exact file Ben has OK'd, and take it out once its Short has aired.

cuts.ok: Ben, 10 Nov 2026 16:22Z, on the board; asked in J2510
cuts.why: The fallback for the Mars helicopter Short. Its full-screen version (v08, J2549) waits for Ben's watch; with no OK by Thu 12 Nov 18:00 London this cut airs, and J2520 has to be able to upload it.
